cards.label: Whitechapel
cards.text: The shop's shutter is halfway down. The blind on the door is turned to closed.
Hakim's on the stool behind the till, holding a tea towel full of ice from the freezer cabinet against his mouth. His lip's split. He keeps trying to talk properly around it.
Des and Nadia are already there. Des isn't shouting. He's gone quiet instead, which nobody in the room has seen him do before, and which is worse.

cards.speaker: Des
cards.text: "Two of them. Made an offer for the shop and what's under it. A fair price, they said."

cards.speaker: Hakim
cards.text: "I said no." He tries to shrug and thinks better of it halfway through. "They didn't love that."
Nobody involved has a name yet. That's apparently how you know it's serious — the people who matter enough to hurt you don't bother introducing themselves.
